---
title: "Kpop albums"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Click an album to explore its tracks and listen to 30-second audio previews. The **⭐ Fan Favorite** badge highlights the most popular track on each album!

```{r}
#| results: asis

library(jsonlite)
library(purrr)

albums <- fromJSON("albums_data.json")

cat('<div class="album-grid">\n')

pwalk(albums, \(artist, album, cover_file, tracks, ...) {
  cat('<details class="album-card" name="kpop-albums">\n')
  cat('<summary>\n')
  cat('<img src="', cover_file, '" alt="', artist, ' - ', album, '" />\n', sep = "")
  cat('<div class="album-title">', album, '</div>\n', sep = "")
  cat('<div class="album-artist">', artist, '</div>\n', sep = "")
  cat('<span class="click-hint">▶ View tracklist</span>\n')
  cat('</summary>\n')
  cat('<ul class="tracklist">\n')
  
  pwalk(tracks, \(track_number, track_name, preview_url, is_favorite, ...) {
    fav_badge <- if (isTRUE(is_favorite)) '<span class="badge-fav">⭐ Fan Favorite</span>' else ''
    cat('<li class="track-item">\n')
    cat('<div class="track-header">\n')
    cat('<span class="track-title">', track_number, '. ', track_name, '</span>\n', sep = "")
    if (fav_badge != "") cat(fav_badge, '\n')
    cat('</div>\n')
    if (!is.null(preview_url) && !is.na(preview_url) && preview_url != "") {
      cat('<audio class="track-audio" controls preload="none" src="', preview_url, '"></audio>\n', sep = "")
    }
    cat('</li>\n')
  })
  
  cat('</ul>\n')
  cat('</details>\n')
})

cat('</div>\n')
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Automatically close other albums and pause audio when switching
document.querySelectorAll('details.album-card').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('toggle', () => {
    if (card.open) {
      document.querySelectorAll('details.album-card').forEach(other => {
        if (other !== card) {
          other.open = false;
          other.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(a => a.pause());
        }
      });
    } else {
      card.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(a => a.pause());
    }
  });
});

// Only play one audio preview at a time
document.addEventListener('play', (e) => {
  if (e.target.tagName === 'AUDIO') {
    document.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(a => {
      if (a !== e.target) a.pause();
    });
  }
}, true);
</script>
```
